sloka: इति दाशरथीरमो लक्ष्मणम् समभाषत ।बलम् च तत्र विभजच्चास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा ॥६-२४-१३॥।।
transliteration: iti dāśarathīramo lakṣmaṇam samabhāṣata ।balam ca tatra vibhajaccāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ॥6-24-13॥।।

translations.english: Dasaratha's son Rama thus talked to Lakshmana in that manner and asked to divide the task of the army in accordance with what is said in sastras.
